profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer | Device & Systems Development | Rust, C/C++, Python
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing RTOS and Linux-based embedded and device-level systems. Proficient in Rust, C/C++, and Python across both firmware and software applications. Background in IEEE 802.15.4 technologies, mainly Zigbee and Thread, as well as secure device communication and cryptographic protocols.

positions.description:
•	Collaborating with multiple Agile teams to implement and maintain Infrared Search & Track (IRST) on modern and legacy fighter jets.

•	Creating Linux & RTOS C/C++ firmware from specifications to run and test of multiple hardware components.

projects.title: Smart Alert Environment Management System (S.A.E.M.S.)
projects.description:
Winner of the Spring 2021 Electrical & Computer Engineering Senior Design Showcase

A ZigBee IoT smart home device that evaluates indoor environmental characteristics, along with the health, safety, and occupancy of an environment. The device integrates multiple sensors that capture the following characteristics:
- Carbon Monoxide
- Carbon Dioxide
- Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs)
- Motion/Occupancy
- Temperature / Humidity / Pressure
- Smoke
- Particulates

The device is compatible with the SmartThings smart home ecosystem and can operate effectively within a ZigBee mesh network; it sends sensor measurements to the SmartThings environment where actions can be taken, from notifying other devices of the data in the network to home automations. 
It also features an onboard 12W LED that has the capability to change its brightness and color through commands sent from the SmartThings app. 
The device contains health & safety reporting features where if the value of Carbon Monoxide or Smoke reaches a certain level, the onboard siren (in the form of a piezo buzzer) will begin to sound and a report will be sent to the SmartThings ecosystem (push notifications, notify other nodes, call emergency services, etc.)

Final Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IFD_q4MwgNI
Critical Design Review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEj7XV7moAA
